headline: Anthropic Packages Claude’s Skills for Reuse
lede: Anthropic’s skills repository turns specialized Claude behavior into portable instruction packages. Each skill carries its own metadata, procedures, examples, and supporting scripts—a modular blueprint for repeatable agent workflows.

headline: Meta Opens Its React Design System
lede: Astryx brings more than 150 accessible React components, themes, and templates into an adaptable StyleX system. Typed APIs, CSS-variable theming, dark mode, and an ejectable CLI give teams a polished visual foundation without locking them into one styling stack.

headline: Sherlock Maps Usernames Across the Open Web
lede: Sherlock scans hundreds of public services for a supplied username, connecting scattered handles without touching private account data. Its command-line workflow gives investigators and individuals a practical way to audit identity reuse—and spot where stronger privacy hygiene is needed.

headline: MuJoCo Makes Contact Physics Computable
lede: MuJoCo models articulated systems, collisions, and contact dynamics through a fast low-level engine built for demanding simulation. Its C core, XML compiler, Python bindings, browser visualizer, and accelerated derivatives give robotics and machine-learning researchers a hard-edged foundation for reproducible experiments.

headline: Claude Quickstarts Lay Out Working Agent Systems
lede: Claude Quickstarts supplies reference architectures for customer support, browser automation, financial analysis, coding, and computer control. The examples expose the plumbing—retrieval, sessions, tool calls, webhooks, memory, review, and deployment—so teams can build from a documented frame instead of a blank repository.

headline: GBrain Gives Agents Portable, Cited Memory
lede: GBrain builds a shared memory layer where agents can store facts, corrections, withdrawn information, and their sources. Retrieval, enrichment, synthesis, permissions, and a typed knowledge graph keep context moving between assistants while preserving provenance and control.

headline: Agent Browser Turns Web Tasks Into Commands
lede: agent-browser gives AI agents a compact accessibility tree and stable references for navigating real websites from the shell. Its Rust CLI preserves sessions, authentication, downloads, screenshots, and debugging while a background daemon keeps the browser state ready for the next command.

headline: RuView Reads Rooms Without Cameras
lede: RuView turns low-cost WiFi reflections into local signals for presence, movement, breathing, occupancy, and more. The playful experiment pairs ESP32 sensing with signal processing, learned models, and smart-home integrations—an ambitious sketch of privacy-preserving ambient intelligence.

headline: One Dashboard Tracks Markets With Language Models
lede: daily_stock_analysis assembles prices, fundamentals, news, sentiment, and technical signals across several global markets, then turns them into scheduled reports and decision dashboards. Its web, desktop, API, and agent interfaces make a sprawling research routine programmable.

headline: HA-MCP Brings Assistants Into Home Assistant
lede: HA-MCP connects Home Assistant to Claude, ChatGPT, and other clients through the Model Context Protocol. With in-process installation, secure webhooks, authentication, backups, and multiple deployment paths, it treats conversational control as an administrable part of the home stack—not a loose automation hack.
